heuristic.description: rebuff's keyword-similarity heuristic, its own scoring

fidelity.claim: the pruned scorer returns the identical float to rebuff's own function: a candidate is skipped only when its base score cannot exceed the running maximum
fidelity.sample_scope: cases of at most 400 characters — verbatim rebuff is O(keywords x words)

label: rebuff (Protect AI) — heuristics only
notes: **this row under-states rebuff, deliberately.** Its deployed detector is heuristics + an LLM judge + a vector store of past attacks + canary tokens; the last three need an OpenAI key and a Pinecone index and do not run offline. Read this as rebuff's floor, never as rebuff.
0.75 is `RebuffSdk.detect_injection`'s own `max_heuristic_score` default, and the SDK flags when the score is strictly greater than it.

latency is rebuff's own function, unmodified, on the same short sample: 5127 ms median on texts of at most 400 characters. On a 1.6 kB document it takes about 90 seconds, which is why the corpus was scored with a pruned scorer proven and measured to return the identical float.
